wallaceFinding: WALLACE, David Foster (box 24) sits at the very start of row 1 — the leftmost book in that row, against the shelf-end upright, so nothing is further left. Its immediate right neighbour is box 25, WALDMAN, Amy. It is filed before the entire WALDMAN/WALDON/WALKER run (boxes 25-47) when it belongs after WALKER. Genuinely misfiled.
confidence: High for rows 0 and 1, where nearly every sticker could be read directly or cross-checked against a duplicate copy of the same book. Labels 10, 18 and 20 are marked illegible because the surname genuinely wraps out of frame around the curved spine edge or into a shadowed gap — the hidden letters were not guessed. Row 2 is a special case: the photo captures only the very tops of those spines, above where a sticker would be, so no white author stickers are visible anywhere in row 2. Labels 48 and 49 are therefore spine and publisher text, and row 2 could not be checked for further misses because the sticker band is simply not in frame.
